description: Angular component for a JavaScript function editor with syntax highlighting, validation, and module management, used within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: JsFuncComponent
classes.description: Angular component providing a code editor for JavaScript functions with syntax highlighting, validation, and module support.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up the Ace editor, and configures event handlers.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties and updates the editor accordingly.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, such as resize observers and editor instances.

methods.name: onAceEditorResize
methods.description: Handles resizing of the Ace editor when the container size changes.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the disabled state of the editor.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the current code, returning validation status.

methods.name: beautifyJs
methods.description: Formats the current JavaScript code for readability.

methods.name: updateFunctionArgsString
methods.description: Updates the string representation of function arguments.

methods.name: updateFunctionLabel
methods.description: Updates the label displayed for the function.

methods.name: updatedScriptLanguage
methods.description: Updates the editor mode based on the selected scripting language.

methods.name: validateOnSubmit
methods.description: Performs validation of the code when submitting.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus to the editor.

methods.name: validateJsFunc
methods.description: Validates the JavaScript function by compiling and executing test.

methods.name: cleanupJsErrors
methods.description: Removes error markers and annotations from the editor.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a new value to the editor, optionally with modules.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates the editor view with the current model value.

methods.name: editModules
methods.description: Opens a popover to edit modules associated with the function.

methods.name: propagateValue
methods.description: Propagates the current code or function object to the form control.

methods.name: updateByChangesPropName
methods.description: Handles updates when specific input properties change.

methods.name: updateHighlightRules
methods.description: Updates syntax highlighting rules based on configuration.

methods.name: updateJsWorkerGlobals
methods.description: Updates global variables for the Ace editor's web worker.

methods.name: updateCompleters
methods.description: Updates code completion providers for the editor.
